games.description: How many games of the match have a RESULT.

abandoned.description: A17: the game that was being played and was ended for everyone: no RESULT, a win for nobody. Null or absent: none.

anyOf.description: 1-based game number within a match (a series, A10).

description: host -> all, between games: the series is over; the last RESULT stands. Never logged; the host closes the match afterwards. In a lobby (A17) it means "this match is over, back to the lobby": nobody leaves, no connection closes, and the next match starts a log of its own.
